post_trade_review.observation: Observed gross profit earlier but negative realized net result. Review earlier profit protection/trailing SL; this is NOT proof a different stop could execute profitably.

price_movement.limitations: 5m OHLC extremes within entry candle may have occurred before fill; 5m bars cannot determine high/low order or true TP-vs-SL first touch. Missing bars are not estimated.
